scope: 75 previously acquired monomer detail records, no HTTP requests or new observations, no natural-model training or train/dev/test access
identity_checks: RDKit sanitize every provided SMILES; no dot fragment stripping or salt removal. Require exactly one connected fragment, neutral formal charge, no isotopic labels or unspecified stereocenters.
All provided tautomer SMILES must have identical formula and average molecular weight; preserve metadata and formula conflicts.

Independently reconstruct standard amino-acid peptide graph from sequence, invert residue stereocenters for lowercase D notation, and apply explicit C-terminal AMD, disulfide bonds and mainchain N-C amide closure. Other unusual residues/modifications or bonds remain pending.
Null terminal objects remain unknown annotations; if SMILES matches unmodified end model, report represented-structure consistency only, not an independent source assertion of free termini.

Require exact stereo graph agreement or only neutral arginine-like guanidine tautomer normalization. Normalize C bonded 3 N, bond orders 1/1/2, 2 terminal N degree1 and 1 chain N degree2; reject labelled/charged/stereospecified motifs. Set chain N single and one terminal N double, reset H only on these N. Require invariant formula/charge/heavy edges/chiral tags, unchanged atoms and bonds outside motif, and 1/2/1 local N hydrogen counts. No generic tautomer search. All source variants must match independently reconstructed graph. Independent elemental formula and average molar mass still required.
conversion: For a structurally matched single neutral parent, conditional parent-peptide-equivalent uM = ug_per_ml * 1000 / verified_represented_parent_MW_g_per_mol. Preserve raw value/unit/operator, strictness and unresolved range/plusminus semantics. This conditional value is not an admitted assay concentration.

pass_refuse_pending.PASS: Structural mass checks pass AND existing record explicitly establishes the assayed mass basis as this covalent parent or specified stoichiometry, independently reviewed.
pass_refuse_pending.REFUSE: Disconnected mixtures/counterions, invalid SMILES, conflicting formula/structure, isotopes or unsupported charge/stoichiometry: do not apply neutral single-parent conversion.
pass_refuse_pending.PENDING: Missing/unsupported chemical detail, stereochemical ambiguity, unmatched supported structure, or assay material mass basis not established. No guessed salt/purity/hydrate correction.

material_basis: Do not equate an auto-generated database SMILES with verified assay material composition. No pre-approved positive mass-basis overrides; source records may supply evidence, but no assumption from unit name alone.
independence: Reuse frozen sample family/group identifiers; report counts of unique IDs/backbones/families/sourcegroups for structural-pass, conditional-convertible, assay-PASS/REFUSE/PENDING and actual newly admitted groups relative to existing34row draft. Chemical checks do not implement contamination isolation.
failure_rules: Preserve all errors and nonpassing records. Any source hash mismatch stops script. Individual chemistry failures remain classified with reason, no replacement or requests.
software: Existing RDKit2023.9.5, Python3.12, standard library; no installs/downloads.
predecessor: v1 preserved unchanged; 41 generic tautomer enumeration cap PENDING outcomes motivate this narrow, independently preaudited algorithm revision. No statistical target optimization.
representation: Report plain 20-AA CNN compatibility separately; D/noncanonical residues, bonds/cycles, terminal modifications and >100 length are not silently discarded. Null terminus stays unknown. Compatibility is not admission.
